scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,extension -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @cravelens/server" "npm run dev -w @cravelens/extension"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cravelens/shared && npm run build -w @cravelens/server && npm run build -w @cravelens/extension
scripts.test:android: npm run export:android && cd apps/android && ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest
scripts.test: npm run test -w @cravelens/server && npm run test -w @cravelens/extension && npm run test -w @cravelens/edge-proxy && node scripts/check-shared-export.mjs
